about: Every image the site uses: where it came from, its licence and its alt text. scripts/check-content.mjs fails on an image in public/ or src/ without an entry. Sources: owner (the owner's own photo or artwork), openverse or stock (needs creator, licence and url), generated (abstract texture or pattern only: never people, premises, products or anything presented as real), framework (shipped by Framework B). "ai" lists what AI did with an image (chose, cropped, treated, alt, drew, generated; the tools write it) and "aiBy" names the model, for the Website assets page.
